formattedAddress: 111, Taiwan, Taipei City, Shilin District, Lanxing Village, Keqiang Rd, 30號1樓

text.text:
We visited on a Thursday afternoon and the space was very clean and completely quiet, which is great if you prefer a calmer play café atmosphere. The setup seems best suited for younger kids.

We mainly came for the beetles and reptiles, but didn’t realize the beetle interaction follows a set schedule. We arrived at 5pm and the next session wasn’t until 6:30pm, so it’s helpful to check the timing in advance.

There is a minimum order requirement, so for me and two kids it came out to about 1500. The waffle with fruit and ice cream was the standout dish for us. The fried cod was similar to fish sticks with tartar sauce, and the chicken curry just wasn’t our flavor profile (a bit more garlicky than expected).

The restaurant place a single song on repeat and it is a Christian lullaby. One song on repeat with the entire time we were there.
